title: Not as good as Binder Clips
text:
Not as good as Binder Clips. I bought these, but there not as strong as Binder Clips, that I bought at the stationary store, and the binder clips are alot Less money, and you get a box of them, not just 4...

I don't keep a bunch of junk cliped on my refigerator, so I kept these OX0 clips in the drawer, they also take up more space then the Binder Clips do...

I'm not impressed with these clips.But I gave them a 2 star for color!!! Big deal lol...

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Bag Clips, Set-of-4, Multicolored
features: Attached magnet great for refrigerator use
description: The colorful, soft-handled All Purpose Clips have convenient magnets so you can store them in easy reach. They're perfect for clipping notes to the fridge, holding open a cookbook, and sealing a bag of pretzels or a sack of coffee beans.

Use these clips to hold up a recipe, clip kindergarten art to the fridge, or seal up a bag of pretzels. With soft, cushioned handles, the clips are easy to open but close tightly, creating an unrivaled grip in the world of kitchen clips. The clips come in a set of four, and are dishwasher-safe. Good Grips products are moderately priced and have won the Tylenol/Arthritis Foundation Design Award.
